d: Join Snoonu as a Grocery Operations Lead, where you will oversee the daily operations of the grocery business, ensuring operational efficiency, service excellence, and consistent execution across all grocery operations. You will lead operational teams, optimize processes, monitor performance, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver an exceptional experience for customers, partners, and employees.

The role oversees the daily activities of grocery pickers, quality checkers, and dispatch teams, managing resources across multiple branches to improve on-ground throughput, reduce bottlenecks, and ensure SLA compliance.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, Retail Management, or a related field.
5–7 years of experience in grocery operations, retail operations, warehouse operations, logistics, or quick-commerce, including leadership experience.
Strong knowledge of end-to-end order fulfillment, including picking, quality control, and dispatch processes.
Strong understanding of operational performance management, inventory control, workforce planning, and service delivery.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to lead cross-functional operational teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience interpreting operational data and driving performance improvements.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with operational dashboards and reporting tools.
Experience working in grocery retail, e-commerce, marketplace, or quick-commerce operations is highly preferred.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and operational initiatives.
